## `neuro.math.min`

Static method on `Math`. Variadic items live under `values`.

> Returns the smaller of a set of supplied numeric expressions.

## Signatures

```ts
min(input: { values: number[]; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Math.min` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
